author: sonnet
label: c2-nat-sonnet-01
changes: Added an Overview and a Terms list so a reader new to the stack gets the three mechanisms (fallback, versioned pointer, shadow) and the vocabulary before the steps
Added `blocked_features` and `live_test` to the stage list in the state overview, and explained `source_ts` and `feature_set_version` there
Step 5: separated the on-fallback behaviour from the daily list refresh, which were mixed in the trigger line
Step 6: moved 'after the response is flushed' into Data moves, and noted that skipping fallback requests means shadow covers only users who had features
Step 8: stated that the feature check is the single rule behind the never-run-without-features requirement, and that steps 9, 10, 15 and 16 repeat it as a guard
Steps 10, 15, 16: reordered Data moves so the feature check is listed before the writes it guards
Step 13: reconciled the 7-day clock wording (outages are excluded, config changes restart it), and made the confidence-interval criterion clearer
Step 12: explained overlap@20; step 11: skipped_features now includes stale records, consistent with the freshness rule
Step 14: rewrote the seam paragraph to remove the contradictory 'nothing built that goes unused' wording, and set it apart from the path options
Minor wording tightening throughout; all steps, numbering, format and open items kept
Added a one-paragraph summary of the request flow to the overview, and defined 'pointer' and 'candidate' in the terms.
Clarified that the registry stage exists per version and gave examples.
Step 5: removed the vague 'unless the front end wants it' clause; the fallback reason is logged but not returned.
Step 8: moved the 'single rule' sentence into a labeled 'Why this matters' bullet and softened it to 'main rule'.
Step 10: split stopping and changing shadow into its own bullet instead of burying it under failure.
Step 13: rewrote criterion 4 so it is a clear pass condition (ceilings set by the team) instead of an unresolved suggestion.
Step 14: corrected the claim that steps 1-16 are independent of the A/B decision by noting the Path A condition in step 15.
Step 3: reworded the note about records never mixing data for clarity.
Minor wording tightening in the inference-failure assumption and step 1 state.
Added a roadmap sentence to the Overview mapping step numbers to topics, and restated the per-step format (starts it, data, state, failure).
Explained the shadow-selection formula in step 6 in plain words (10% means the lowest 1,000 of 10,000 hash buckets).
Named the step 8 check 'the feature check' so later references to it are unambiguous.
Gave step 7's new-feature note its own labelled bullet instead of burying it under failures.
Clarified gate criterion 5 (why a minimum pair count is needed).
Minor wording tightening; no requirements, assumptions or decisions changed.
